proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.item_or_object
proposed_widenings.justification: Tree Form changes the staff itself into a tree and back. The current activation surface can only attach to self, target, area, or mark, so there is no honest attachment site for alter_item_kind on the item.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take a Magic action to plant one end of the staff in earth in an unoccupied space and expend 1 charge to transform the staff into a healthy tree.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_numeric.spell_attack_only
proposed_widenings.justification: The item grants +2 to spell attack rolls only. The current roll surface can target generic attack rolls, but it cannot distinguish spell attacks from weapon attacks for a passive rider.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While holding it, you have a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls.

proposed_widenings.name: fall_on_end
proposed_widenings.justification: Tree Form has a deterministic rider when the altered item reverts: creatures in the tree fall. The v4 taxonomy already names this atom, but the authored TS surface does not expose it.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Any creature in the tree falls when the tree reverts to a staff.

proposed_widenings.name: ItemDestructionPolicy.last_charge_roll_nonmagical
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing last-charge policy only models destruction. This item survives but loses its magical properties, which is materially different lifecycle behavior.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff loses its properties and becomes a nonmagical Quarterstaff.

proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord.attunementRestriction
proposed_widenings.justification: The record can only say attunement is required, not who can attune. This item's attunement gate is class-specific.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Staff, Rare (Requires Attunement by a Druid)

notes: Composite magic-item mechanics would cover the passive bonuses, spell list, charge pool, and dawn recharge, but Tree Form and the non-destructive last-charge rider cannot be encoded honestly in the current read-only surface.
